chunks.text: Hi there, I'm Tucker Balch. I'm a professor at Georgia Tech and I'm the instructor for this course.

chunks.title: Introduction
chunks.text: Hi, I'm Dev Priyadave, a graduate student at Georgia Tech. You can call me Dave.

chunks.title: Introduction
chunks.text: My original research was about machine learning for robotics, but in 2007 I became interested in using these same algorithms for investing.

chunks.title: Introduction
chunks.text: Since that time I've shifted my research and teaching towards finance.

chunks.title: Introduction
chunks.text: I also co-founded a financial technology company called Lucena Research.

chunks.title: Introduction
chunks.text: I'm a graduate student who's been working with professors to build a predictive system for stock market.

chunks.title: Introduction
chunks.text: I'm also working on the software to support this course.

chunks.title: Introduction
chunks.text: You're going to see a lot of Dave in this course. She makes a lot of things happen behind the scenes.

chunks.title: Introduction
chunks.text: Now, Dave, I'm thinking about buying Apple stock. Do you think I should do it?

chunks.title: Introduction
chunks.text: Well, it depends on a lot of factors. What are the other stocks in your portfolio?

chunks.title: Introduction
chunks.text: What do you think will predict stock prices? Also, how much risk do you think you can take it on?

chunks.title: Introduction
chunks.text: So those are all good questions, and Dave is exactly right. We need to consider all of those things before we make an investment.

chunks.title: Introduction
chunks.text: Now, in this course we're going to cover a lot of these issues.
